description: This file is a Perl script implementing a mock FTP, SMTP, IMAP, and POP3 server primarily for testing purposes in the curl test suite. It handles various protocol commands, manages socket connections, and simulates server responses for testing client behavior.

methods.name: exit_signal_handler
methods.description: Handles termination signals to clean up socket filters, remove lock files, and exit gracefully.

methods.name: ftpmsg
methods.description: Appends a message to the server input log file for debugging or tracing purposes.

methods.name: sysread_or_die
methods.description: Performs a sysread on the given filehandle, exits the program on failure.

methods.name: startsockfilt
methods.description: Starts the sockfilt process with specified parameters for the server.

methods.name: read_mainsockf
methods.description: Reads data from the primary socket filter with optional timeout handling.

methods.name: read_datasockf
methods.description: Reads data from the secondary socket filter with optional timeout handling.

methods.name: sendcontrol
methods.description: Sends a control command to the client, optionally delaying each byte to simulate network conditions.

methods.name: senddata
methods.description: Sends data over the data socket to the client, handling active/passive modes and delays.

methods.name: close_dataconn
methods.description: Closes the data connection, performing handshake if needed and killing sock filters.
